<a id="page-index"></a>
# Index

The reference is one base plus one page per feature area. Read [the base](STARTER.md) first, in full. Then use
this page to find the one section you need: the task table below says where each need is answered, the A–Z lists
every node type, behavior, trigger, action, formula function, model, enum and value type with the page that
documents it, and the page list says what each page covers. Every page has the same sections: When to use,
Minimal example, Reference, Patterns, Pitfalls, See also. At run time the same map is the `ui_docs` tool: a
section's anchor is its topic.

<a id="index-the-pages"></a>
## The pages

| Page | What it covers | Words |
|---|---|---|
| [STARTER.md](STARTER.md) | The base (give it up front): the document, layout, decoration, text, the base node types, state, reactions, the rules. | 4811 |
| [layout.md](layout.md) | Sizes, rows, columns, stacks, scrolling and screen sizes beyond the base: every layout field, which sizing modes each parent allows, media rules and breakpoints, and the web layouts agents ask for (a page gutter, cards that wrap, a row turning into a column, a sticky header). | 9529 |
| [theme.md](theme.md) | A site's palette and type scale, declared once and named everywhere; dark mode and a type scale that changes with the screen size; and the `text` node in depth (runs, links, superscripts, fonts, text direction). | 2906 |
| [decoration.md](decoration.md) | What a node's box paints beyond the base: gradients, pixel patterns and grain, borders on some sides, shadows and blurs, scrims over children, images, icons, SVG-like paths and custom drawing. | 4097 |
| [forms.md](forms.md) | Buttons, text fields, checkboxes, switches, radios, sliders, dropdowns, segmented buttons, date and time pickers, chips and signatures: every control's props, **how to style each one (in one place, below)**, two-way binding to a variable, validation and error states, focus and the keyboard. | 12891 |
| [lists.md](lists.md) | Anything repeated from data: lists and grids from one item template, nested lists (`item`, `index`, `parent`), equal-height card grids, tables, carousels (`pageView`), list tiles, pagination, pull to refresh, swipe actions and reordering. | 7877 |
| [navigation.md](navigation.md) | Several screens and moving between them, a page's URL path, passing values to a screen, dialogs, bottom sheets and popovers, confirmations and toasts, app bars, navigation bars, tabs and disclosure (accordions). | 4238 |
| [state.md](state.md) | Variables and where they live, computed and function variables, expressions and every binding path with the value it expects, conditions, the formula functions (grouped: text, numbers, money, lists, objects, dates, colours), the actions that change state, and sandboxed scripts. | 6662 |
| [interaction.md](interaction.md) | What a node does when it is tapped, hovered, pressed, dragged or swiped: reactions and every trigger, hover and pressed styles (`states`), ink ripples, tooltips, letting taps through, drag and drop, values set by dragging (`track`), swipe to dismiss, pan, pinch and rotate, keys, the clipboard and haptics. | 5250 |
| [animation.md](animation.md) | Anything that moves: a change that animates (implicit transitions), keyframe animations and presets, moving, scaling and turning a node without changing layout (`motion`), shared-element flights (`hero`), reveal on scroll, shimmer, typewriter text, particles, flip cards and tilt, and the timer and frame triggers for clocks and games. | 4769 |
| [components.md](components.md) | Splitting a page into parts, each a file: a component used in several places with different values (a card, a chip, a row), a section used once (a header, a hero, an FAQ), their parameters (every kind, `variable` included), slots and events, the site manifest, and when to use a component, a list template or a section. | 3719 |
| [design-systems.md](design-systems.md) | Giving every screen one look that is not the renderer's default and not the host app's: a set of components (buttons, fields, selects, cards, dialogs...) drawn from core nodes, the tokens they are styled with, and the two documents an author reads first, the principles and the patterns. | 839 |
| [charts.md](charts.md) | Showing numbers as pictures: progress bars and rings, activity spinners, badges, gauges, bar, line and series charts, scatter plots and barcodes. | 7160 |
| [data.md](data.md) | The `data` feature library: calling HTTP APIs, reading and writing the project's cloud documents and files, storing values on the device, and submitting forms. | 2308 |
| [auth.md](auth.md) | The `auth` feature library: signing app users in, up and out, and managing their account, with `${auth}` to show who is signed in. | 470 |
| [commerce.md](commerce.md) | The `commerce` feature library: a paywall screen's interactions (buy, restore, select a product, close, open a legal link). | 439 |
| [media.md](media.md) | The `media` feature library: video players, embedded videos, an audio player, web views, reading text aloud, playing sounds, printing, capturing a screenshot, downloading a file and preloading images. | 1998 |
| [engage.md](engage.md) | The `engage` feature library: firing app events that the project's automations listen for (a popup after a lesson, a review prompt after the third order), and the `${usage}` counters they read. | 311 |
| [publish.md](publish.md) | What happens to documents after they are written: a published app's model (its layouts, components, theme and identity), page paths and titles, components published by reference, managed component releases and hosted plugins. | 672 |
| [edit-ops.md](edit-ops.md) | Building and changing a document with edit operations: what a model sends in a `ui_apply` tool call, what an app's `UiSession` applies while the model streams, the retry protocol for rejected ops, the tools' schemas and the trust profiles that limit what a model may use. | 3581 |
| [render.md](render.md) | Checking a document or a site before trusting it: strict validation, screenshots at each size, the states after taps, typing and scrolling, and a diagnostic for every problem with a code, a JSON pointer and what to do. | 3020 |
| [values.md](values.md) | Looking up how one value is written: a value type (a colour, an alignment, insets), a model no feature page shows (its fields) or an enum (its names). | 13353 |
